__meta: REUSABLE. Intent distribution from Azure Monitor Logs over IVR AppTraces call.intent customDimension (a correlation tag stamped by CallCorrelationEnrichmentProcessor). Pie/donut of detected intents — the categorical-distribution archetype (reference intent_found/not_found), retargeted at our correlation tags.
title: Detected intent distribution
description: Distribution of detected caller intents from IVR telemetry (call.intent tag).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated $__timeFilter()
| extend Intent = tostring(Properties['call.intent'])
| where isnotempty(Intent)
| summarize Calls = dcount(tostring(Properties['e2e.call_id'])) by Intent
| order by Calls desc
